Invalid inputs:
- bad_crc.bin: Checksum
- unsupported_version.bin: Version(2) after valid framing
- unsupported_type.bin: UnsupportedType(99) after valid framing
- invalid_cbor.bin: invalid/indefinite CBOR
- duplicate_keys.bin: duplicate numeric map key
- duplicate_widget_ids.bin: duplicate widget identifiers
- duplicate_screen_ids.bin: duplicate screen identifiers
- missing_widget_reference.bin: screen references an unknown widget
- unsupported_template_config.bin: unknown template enum
- unsupported_size_config.bin: reserved tile size in M2
- config_too_many_widgets.bin: configuration capacity exceeded
- config_too_many_screens.bin: configuration capacity exceeded
- invalid_config_utf8.bin: invalid UTF-8 identifier
- duplicate_field_names.bin: duplicate PushData field name
- zero_request_config.bin: host request uses request ID zero
- nonzero_request_event.bin: DeviceEvent uses a nonzero request ID
- overlong.bin: encoded frame overflow then delimiter
- garbage.bin: malformed COBS/frame
